Ohio.focus: Innovation hubs, EMS transformation, school-based health and mobile care
Ohio.description: Ohio's plan targets 4.4 million residents of its 73 non-urban counties, where thirteen counties are maternity care deserts and nearly one in five rural hospitals is at risk of closure.
initiatives: Rural Health Innovation Hubs
Clinically integrated networks and regional centers of excellence linking hospitals, clinics, EMS and pharmacists.
Emergency Care Transformation
Scaling an EMS treat-in-place and alternate-destination pilot.
School-Based Health Centers
Clinics on K–12 and college campuses offering primary, behavioral, dental and telehealth services.
OH SEE
Statewide mobile vision, hearing and dental care, expanded from a 13-county pilot.

Oklahoma.focus: Six initiatives from care-model innovation to a health data utility
Oklahoma.description: The Oklahoma State Department of Health plans six initiatives developed with health systems, Tribal Nations and rural residents.
initiatives: Innovating the care model
Modernized care delivery to improve access and outcomes.
Moving upstream
Preventive care and root causes of disease through innovative delivery and technology.
Regional collaboration and shifting to value
Stronger provider infrastructure, regional partnerships and value-based care models.
Rural talent and health data utility
Growing the rural workforce and building a health data utility.

Oregon.focus: Regional partnerships, prevention, workforce, technology and a Tribal initiative
Oregon.description: Oregon, where 33% of residents live in rural and frontier communities, plans five initiatives led by the Oregon Health Authority.
initiatives: Regional Partnerships & System Transformation
Regional collaboration to improve care efficiency.
Healthy Communities & Prevention
Prevention-rooted community health.
Workforce Capacity & Resilience
Building a resilient rural workforce.
Technology & Data Modernization and Tribal Initiative
Data-driven solutions, plus a dedicated Tribal initiative.

Pennsylvania.focus: Eight regional Rural Care Collaboratives and technology-enabled models
Pennsylvania.description: Pennsylvania plans regionally led, technology-enabled models delivered through eight Rural Care Collaboratives run by its Partnerships for Regional Economic Performance organizations.
initiatives: Rural Health priorities
Maternity, behavioral health, dental, aging, and primary and preventive care identified by rural stakeholders.
Rural Care Collaboratives
Eight regional collaboratives prioritizing local needs, shared services, telehealth and clinical integration.
Regional digital hubs
Supporting providers in vetting and adopting AI and other technology tools.

Rhode Island.focus: 13 initiatives for rural and island communities
Rhode Island.description: Rhode Island's EOHHS plans a coordinated set of 13 initiatives for rural and island communities, with partners including Block Island Health Services and the Narragansett Indian Tribe.
initiatives: Community clinical care hubs
Rural community health networks linking clinical, behavioral health and community organizations with CHWs.
Community-integrated and mobile health
Preventive, dental and maternal-child care through mobile units and telehealth sites in schools.
Accessibility investments
Investments for rural providers and communities to improve access.
